question:
Select the most appropriate option to improve the bold part of the sentence.

Seldom **we have seen** such a performance.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence begins with "**Seldom**," which is an adverb of frequency. When such adverbs are used at the start of a sentence, they typically require an inversion of the subject and auxiliary verb.
 
• In this case, "**have we seen**" maintains proper inversion and grammatical correctness.
 
• The incorrect phrase "**Seldom we have seen**" does not follow the rule of inversion.
 
• Thus, the correct usage is "**Seldom have we seen**."

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"Seldom have we seen such a performance."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "had we seen"** – This phrase is incorrect because it uses the past perfect tense, which is not appropriate for this context.
 
• **Option 2: "did we saw"** – This option is grammatically incorrect because "saw" cannot follow "did" in a sentence.
 
• **Option 4: "we had seen"** – This phrase lacks proper inversion and does not fit the structure required after "seldom."
